openings: This agreement is made between {{first}} (the "Supplier") and {{second}} (the "Customer").

The Supplier provides technology consulting, implementation and support services. This agreement sets out the master terms on which the Supplier will provide services to the Customer from time to time. Each engagement will be described in a statement of work signed by both parties, and each statement of work forms a separate contract incorporating these terms.
This agreement is entered into by {{second}} ("{{secondShort}}" or the "Customer") and {{first}} ("{{firstShort}}" or the "Supplier").

{{secondShort}} wishes to appoint {{firstShort}} as a non-exclusive provider of professional services over the term of this agreement. No services are ordered by this agreement itself: the Customer orders specific work by signing a statement of work, which states its scope, deliverables, timetable and fees, and these master terms govern every statement of work.

sections.heading: Statements of Work
variants: Each statement of work shall describe the services, the deliverables, the timetable, the fees and any assumptions on which the Supplier relies. A statement of work binds the parties only once both have signed it.
If a statement of work conflicts with these master terms, these master terms prevail, unless the statement of work names the clause it varies and states that it is intended to vary it.

The Customer may request services at any time by sending the Supplier a draft statement of work. The Supplier shall respond within ten working days, either accepting the draft or proposing changes to it, and no statement of work takes effect until signed by an authorised representative of each party.
Where a statement of work and these master terms are inconsistent, these master terms take precedence.

sections.heading: Services
variants: The Supplier shall perform the services described in each statement of work with reasonable skill and care, in accordance with good industry practice, and using appropriately qualified personnel.
The Customer shall give the Supplier reasonable access to its premises, systems and staff as the services require, and shall make decisions promptly where the Supplier needs them.

The Supplier shall provide the services in accordance with each statement of work and any service levels it sets out, and shall comply with the Customer's reasonable site rules when working at the Customer's premises.
If the Supplier expects to miss a date set out in a statement of work, it shall notify the Customer promptly, explain the cause, and propose a plan to recover the delay.

sections.heading: Personnel
variants: The Supplier shall name a delivery manager for each statement of work, who shall be the Customer's day-to-day contact. The Supplier shall not replace the delivery manager, or any other key person named in a statement of work, without the Customer's prior consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

The Supplier remains responsible for the acts and omissions of its personnel and subcontractors. It may subcontract services only with the Customer's prior written consent, and shall remove from the services any individual the Customer reasonably objects to.

sections.heading: Fees and Payment
variants: The Customer shall pay the fees set out in each statement of work. Unless a statement of work states otherwise, the Supplier shall invoice monthly in arrears and the Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty days of receipt.
The Customer shall notify any disputed amount within fifteen days of receiving the invoice, giving its reasons, and the parties shall try in good faith to resolve the dispute promptly.
Fees are charged on a time and materials basis at the rates in the relevant statement of work, unless it states a fixed price. Invoices are payable within thirty days of receipt.

The Supplier may increase its rates once in each twelve-month period from the date this agreement starts, by no more than the increase in the Consumer Prices Index, on sixty days' written notice. An increase does not apply to a fixed price already agreed.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
variants: Each party keeps the intellectual property it owned before a statement of work began. Deliverables created specifically for the Customer under a statement of work belong to the Customer once it has paid for them, and the Supplier grants the Customer a perpetual licence to use any of the Supplier's pre-existing materials included in them.

The Supplier owns its tools, methods and know-how, including any it improves while performing the services. On payment, the Customer owns the deliverables named in each statement of work, and receives a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence of any Supplier material incorporated in them, for its own business purposes.

sections.heading: Liability
variants: Neither party limits its liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud. Subject to that, each party's total liability in each twelve-month period from the date this agreement starts is limited to the fees paid or payable in that period under all statements of work, and neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.

Neither party is liable for any indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit. Each party's aggregate liability under this agreement is capped at one hundred and twenty-five per cent of the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim, save for liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: Term and Termination
variants: This agreement runs for three years and then continues until either party gives six months' written notice. Termination of this agreement ends every statement of work then in force unless the parties agree otherwise.
Either party may terminate this agreement or any statement of work immediately by notice if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty days of being notified of it.

This agreement starts on signature and continues until terminated. Either party may end it on ninety days' written notice, but a statement of work in force at that time continues on these terms until its services are complete.
The Customer may end a statement of work early on thirty days' notice, and shall then pay for the services performed up to the date of termination.

sections.heading: General
variants: This agreement, together with each statement of work, is the entire agreement between the parties about its subject matter. Any variation must be in writing and signed by both parties. This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Neither party may assign this agreement without the other's written consent. Notices must be in writing and sent to the receiving party's registered office. This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and its courts have exclusive jurisdiction.
